name: Cleveland Clinic
notes: Catalog record is the main campus (no system-level record); Cleveland Clinic bills system-wide through MyChart. Researched from public my.clevelandclinic.org billing pages (no sign-in). Pay Online in MyChart, Pay a Bill (guest page), Pay By Phone 1.866.621.6385 (have the personal ID number from page one of the statement), by mail, or in person at certain locations. Since September 2022 billing is paperless and monthly statements are paid in MyChart; patients can switch back to paper in MyChart. Zero Interest Payment Options: self-service plan in MyChart, 3-48 months by balance ($0+ 3 mo, $150+ 6, $750+ 12, $1,500+ 18, $2,250+ 24, $3,000+ 36, $4,000+ 48); a plan is cancelled if the monthly minimum is not received within 60 days; collection and insurance balances are not eligible. Accepted methods, fees and AutoPay are not published (family defaults kept). Customer Service hours Mon-Thu 8-6, Fri 8-4:30 ET.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay Online in MyChart, where you can view statements and pay electronically, or use Pay a Bill to pay without logging in.
Pay By Phone at 1.866.621.6385; have the personal ID number from the first page of your statement ready. You can also pay by mail or in person at certain Cleveland Clinic locations.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Since September 2022 Cleveland Clinic bills paperlessly: monthly statements are delivered and paid in MyChart. To get paper statements again, change the setting in the MyChart app or on the MyChart website.

help.title: Zero Interest Payment Options
paragraphs: Set up an interest-free payment plan yourself in MyChart and choose your first payment date. The length depends on the balance: 3 months for any balance, 6 months from $150, 12 months from $750, 18 months from $1,500, 24 months from $2,250, 36 months from $3,000 and 48 months from $4,000.

You can add family members' balances from the payment plan section of your MyChart account summary. If the monthly minimum is not received within 60 days, the plan is cancelled; that balance returns to normal billing, may go to collections and cannot join a new plan. Collection-agency and insurance balances are not eligible.
steps: Open the payment plan section of your account summary.
Choose a plan length your balance qualifies for.
Pick the first payment date and confirm.

help.title: Financial assistance
paragraphs: Cleveland Clinic offers financial assistance based on federal income guidelines. Self-pay patients and those whose insurance is not accepted can speak with a Patient Financial Advocate. For more help call 800.223.2273.

help.title: Billing Customer Service
paragraphs: Customer Service: 866.621.6385, Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern. You can also schedule a customer service callback.

extra.intent: Using Cleveland Clinic's billing help, find the smallest balance that qualifies for a 48-month zero-interest payment plan. Do not set up a plan or make a payment.
Find out after how many days without the monthly minimum a Cleveland Clinic payment plan is cancelled. Do not change anything on the account.
